summary: The comments from a federally funded Head Start agency in Sacramento, California urge the FCC to preserve the E-Rate program in full and maintain E-Rate support for Head Start and pre-kindergarten students without new cost-allocation requirements. The IT chief argues that E-Rate is necessary for connectivity in early learning programs and that removing the discount would have negative impacts on program integrity and continuity.
